Subject: Your geographical-indication dispute matter - CS(COMM) 2883/2024

Dear Mr. Srivastava,

Thank you for meeting us on 13/10/2024 about your dispute with Pandey Foods Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the rival product uses the protected regional name on its label.

Our advice is to rely on the registered GI certificate and seek an injunction against the infringing label. Please collect the registered GI certificate and samples of the infringing label and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
